title: New in Symfony 8.2: Encrypted Doctrine Columns
content:
<html><head></head><body>The new KeyManagement component includes a Doctrine DBAL bridge with an
EncryptedType that encrypts any column with envelope encryption. You need
a separate Doctrine type for each combination of key and value type, registered
before the first query runs.…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
